pending.title: micro1: Legal Counsel
pending.description:
Role Title: Legal CounselRole Type: ContractorLocation: Remote
micro1 is engaging Legal Counsels to contribute their legal expertise on a customer's project focused on shaping the future of AI technologies. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for those who excel at both detailed legal analysis and clear, effective communication, with a special emphasis placed on written and verbal skills.
Scope of Work
Analyze and review diverse legal documents, providing insightful interpretations and relevant feedback.
Draft, edit, and evaluate contracts, policies, and regulatory materials to ensure clarity, compliance, and accuracy.
Identify potential legal risks and propose solutions aligned with current laws and best practices.
Translate complex legal concepts into clear and accessible language for various project deliverables.
Create and refine sample legal scenarios, FAQs, or hypothetical situations to inform AI learning modules.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure alignment on project objectives and legal standards.
Contribute to the development of guidelines and frameworks that support ethical AI practices and compliance.
Preferred Qualifications
Active legal qualification and significant professional experience in legal practice.
Expertise in contract law, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, or technology-related legal fields.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a strong focus on clarity and precision.
Proven ability to interpret, draft, and analyze complex legal materials.
Familiarity with international legal frameworks or cross-border compliance considerations.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams or working in dynamic, remote environments.
Interest in the intersection of law, technology, and AI innovation is a plus.
